title: The zoning identification system is based on Method A.  The access panels are identified by the zone number in which the
rule_xml: <structureObjectRule><objectPath allowedObjectFlag="0">/dmodule/content/procedure//zoneRef[@id][(not(starts-with(@id,"zon-")and((string-length(@id)=8)or(string-length(@id)=9)or(string-length(@id)=10))))or(not(@zoneNumber))or(not((string-length(@zoneNumber)=3)))or(string-length(translate(translate(normalize-space(substring(@zoneNumber,1,3)),concat("1234567890", '"'), ""), '"', "")) != 0)]</objectPath><objectUse>The zoning identification system is based on Method A.  The access panels are identified by the zone number in which they are installed and by a suffix of two letters. The suffix is made up of one identification letter and one location letter. The second suffix letter (or locator) identifies the panel in its relation to the aircraft as required, e.g.: - T - Top - B - Bottom - L - Left Hand - R - Right Hand - Z - Internal - F - Floor Panel  If all letters of the alphabet are used, panel identification is continued by starting again with the letter "A" and using one of the following as the second letter: - U - Top - D - Bottom - P - Left Hand - S - Right Hand - G - Floor Panel (Chap. 3.4 Para_2.1.1).</objectUse></structureObjectRule>
